class.name: BulletWobbleData2D
class.brief_description: Sine/cos flight modulation for danmaku snakes, weaves, and petals.
class.description: Attach as [member DirectionalBulletsData2D.shared_bullet_wobble_data] (one resource fans out per bullet via [member phase_step_per_bullet]) or per bullet via [member DirectionalBulletsData2D.all_bullet_wobble_data]. Lateral mode weaves perpendicular to flight; Angular mode oscillates the heading. Set [member enabled] to true, otherwise the entry is skipped.

members.member: Master switch for this entry. Disabled entries are skipped per bullet.
0 = Lateral (weave perpendicular to flight), 1 = Angular (oscillate heading in degrees).
Wobble size in pixels (Lateral) or degrees (Angular). Must be finite and >= 0.
Oscillations per second. Must be finite and >= 0.
Base phase in radians. Each bullet adds [member phase_step_per_bullet] times its index.
Per-bullet phase fan-out. One shared resource with a non-zero step makes snakes and petals instead of synced waves.
Phase from distance traveled instead of time, so speed changes do not warp the shape.
Exponential decay of the wobble over time. 0 = undamped.
Seconds of straight flight before wobble starts.
Seconds of wobble before it stops. 0 = infinite.
